title: Soukyuu Gurentai
overview:
We're a hazard contracting unit. Intercepting the enemy is our company's job!

In addition to a complete port of the arcade version, a new "Training Mode" has been added!

Soukyuu Gurentai is a vertically scrolling sci-fi shooter for one or two players, with scaling, rotating sprites and stages that blend 2D and 3D. Its signature weapon is the lock-on web: hold the shot button and a wireframe net spreads out from your ship, and every target caught in it is hit at once. Tap the button for your regular shot, collect falling P icons to power it up, and save your emergency bombs for tight spots.

Choose from three ships and pilots:
- Toryu (balance type), flown by Kaoru Yashida
- Shiden (speed type), flown by Ryota Mikazuki
- Houga (power type), flown by Rika Kunimura

Each ship has its own shot and web shape, plus an alternate web you can switch to. New options open up as you score higher and play more. Mission Stick and multi controller supported.
